test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 21 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e9fbcb69a53d05912fdc563b45162255e5151ef826c630c7f7e0178b056edde.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: Inner circle rotates 1 place, 2 place, 3 place, and 4 place respectevely.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a3667fd8aa12e32446b862e5b0fdb6958634302b69c07240121cfaed1646f63.png] 

Step II: Outer circle interchange its places to next box.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/915cb160f8e744bc537148f7cc5e4dd88eb667470ecbee754e48336aa2d6a1d4.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
